contradictions.claim_b: [G02/04-29 imrad_framework, 08-60 direction_cards] 死四道規範定義之四 = 『clustering = germline-allelic』(LOSO / AUC=0.505 / ~4%sens+COLO829 / clustering=germline-allelic)。

contradictions.which_correct: claim_b 正確。Primary: G02 canonical_four_deaths = [LOSO circularity / |Δβ|AUC=0.505 / ~4%sens+COLO829 TP≈FP / clustering=germline-allelic(B2 NEGATIVE funnel.md:20+ledger:60/64)]。Zone-Aware QS 是 MEMORY.md 另一條 concluded-NEGATIVE(characterization-only), grep 不在死四道 primary 數字檔(ledger/funnel/loso_findings/condition_fp_consensus), 非死四道成員。
contradictions.correction_needed: 改 integ_chapter (02-24): 第四道由『Zone-Aware QS NEG + CNV-zone filter』改回 canonical『clustering=germline-allelic (B2 NEGATIVE, TP≈het p=0.922)』。Zone-Aware 可另列為 concluded-NEGATIVE 旁證, 但不可佔死四道第四席。

contradictions.subject: strong-ASM OR=0.194 的 provenance tier (anti-discriminative 量級的證據級)
contradictions.claim_a: [G07/07-25 doc_library, 08-31 direction_cards, 11-24 catalog_provenance] 把 strong-ASM OR=0.194 當作 file-stored primary 數值引用(11-24 標 🟢 match)。
contradictions.claim_b: 稽核實證: OR=0.194 在 primary 檔 obs20_forest_stats.json 內被明標『per synthesis』, primary 只直存 rate (TP_strong_rate=0.00337 / FP_strong_rate=0.03331); 0.194 為 synthesis/memory 衍生數, 非 primary 直接 emit。
contradictions.conflict: 同一 strong-ASM OR=0.194 被部分文件當 primary 真值(🟢 match), 但其 primary 檔僅存 rate 並標『per synthesis』; OR=0.194 是衍生量而非原生 emit, tier 標記在文件間不一致(🟡 vs 🟢)。方向(anti-discriminative, FP-enriched)兩說一致, 僅該數字的 provenance 級別矛盾。
contradictions.which_correct: claim_b 正確(部分判定)。Primary obs20_forest_stats.json 標 OR=0.194『per synthesis』, 直存 rate 0.00337 vs 0.03331(~9.9× rate ratio); 方向 anti-discriminative 為 primary-backed, 但 0.194 標 🟢-primary 過強, 應標 P-caveat/S(synthesis-derived)。
contradictions.correction_needed: 改 catalog_provenance (11-24) 把 OR=0.194 由 🟢 primary-match 降為『synthesis-derived (primary 只有 rate 0.00337/0.03331, OR per synthesis)』; doc_library (07-25) 兼修上條檔存在性。方向結論不變。
